title: configunstableCreateDashboardFromClassicRequest
description:
CreateDashboardFromClassicRequest converts raw classic (Grafana) dashboard
JSON into the standard dashboard format and creates the result as a standard
Dashboard entity in one call. Unlike CreateClassicDashboard, this does NOT
create a classic dashboard entity - the result is a standard Dashboard,
indistinguishable from one created via CreateDashboard.

classic_dashboard_json.description: Required raw classic (Grafana) dashboard JSON to convert.

collection_slug.description: Required slug of the collection the new dashboard will belong to.

name.description:
Optional name for the new dashboard. Defaults to the classic dashboard's
`title` when unset.

slug.description:
Optional slug for the new dashboard. When unset, a slug is generated from
the name (same behavior as CreateDashboard).

dry_run.description: When true, converts and validates the dashboard without persisting it.
